_comment: Per-prospect hand-verified content. Highest priority — beats capture, AI, and pack defaults. Keyed by slug. Use to correct any demo whose real services didn't extract cleanly. Fields: name (business name, used when the site title is a placeholder), services[], serviceDetails[] ({h,p}: hand-written from the source site; replaces extracted service copy), headline, subhead, about, specialty.

vaughn-law-com.headline: Fractional counsel and M&A advisors for closely held businesses.
vaughn-law-com.subhead: We serve as fractional general counsel and sell-side M&A advisors, guiding owners of $5M–$100M companies from strategy to a profitable exit.
vaughn-law-com.about: The Vaughn Law Offices provide fractional general counsel — strategic, legal, and operational guidance — and act as lead sell-side M&A advisors for closely held companies valued between $5M and $100M. Led by Justin Vaughn, a former litigation attorney, the firm guides owners through every phase from preparation and positioning to a successful exit.

movechurch-ca.headline: WELCOME TO MOVE CHURCH
movechurch-ca.subhead: Move Church is a local church serving the Franktown, Carleton Place, Smiths Falls area by calling higher, engaging deeper and impacting greater for the glory of God.

serviceDetails.p: A yearly well-woman check-up and its lab work — most insurance covers the wellness exam in full each year.
Physicians and nurse-midwives care for you as one team, with hospital birth at Littleton and Castle Rock Adventist Hospitals.
Certified Nurse-Midwives provide full-scope care: pregnancy, well-woman physicals and gynecology.
Birth control counseling and in-office procedures, including IUDs and Nexplanon, done by our physicians.
Our physicians are trained in surgical procedures for a wide range of women's health issues, many done as outpatient care.
Expert evaluation of urinary and pelvic problems such as incontinence, with surgical and non-surgical options.
Bio-identical hormone replacement using the pellet method, for symptoms of perimenopause and menopause.
Telemedicine visits by phone or computer for hormone consults, weight-loss follow-ups, lab results and more.
